senses.gloss:
र The twenty-seventh consonant of the Nāgari Alphabet, correspond-
ing to the letter R.

र m. (-रः)
 1. Fire or Agni.
 2. Heat, warmth.
 3. Burning, scorching.
 4.
Love, desire.
 5. Speed.
 f. (-रा)
 1. Giving.
 2. Gold.
 f. (-री) Going,
moving.
 E. रा to give, or रम् to play, &c., aff. ड ।

रा r. 2nd. cl. (राति)
 1. To get, to gain, to receive.
 2. To give.
